issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returns a double, but the solution implementation declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int. This return-type mismatch can cause confusion about the expected API and may make tests (which expect a double) fail or prevent students from implementing the method to match the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML/spec by changing the solution (and template stub) method signature to return double: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). Implement it to compute fractional students per tutor, e.g. return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); (or, alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to require an int if integer division was intended).
